text:
maria: Heads-up — orca-lite-2 prod rollout target Fri 09:00 PST. Early perf runs show ~2.8x tokens/sec vs orca-lite-1 for short-chat (avg seq=128). Need a quick capacity + GPU-hour projection and pre-warm plan. Any obvious red flags?

alex: @maria can you paste the bench config that produced 2.8x? want to see batch/seq/instance.

maria: quick paste from bench (local p4d run):
```
model: orca-lite-2
hw: p4d.24xlarge
batch: 8
seq: 128
tokens/s: 56000
baseline (orca-lite-1): 20000
```
Numbers noisy but consistent trend.

jiang: If throughput translates to farm, per-GPU ~56k t/s on that instance. With our standard pod (8 GPUs) that's ~448k t/s per pod.

devon: Our routing config currently assumes ~150k t/s per 4-GPU rack for orca-lite-1. Need to recalc how many pods/racks for new model. Also watch KV cache mem pressure for longer sequences.

sam: Back-of-envelope: product expects baseline 2k req/s with avg 120 tokens -> 240k t/s baseline. If marketing doubles traffic and model is heavier, assume 2.5x baseline -> 600k t/s. For safety factor 3x -> 720k t/s.

maria: Ops ask: for first 90 days assume a 2.5x sustained uplift with occasional 4x spikes during peak events. Recommend reserved capacity + burst. Thoughts?

alex: One p4d pod ~= 448k t/s (from jiang). So 720k needs 2 pods (~896k capacity). Include safety 1.5x -> 3 pods recommended to keep headroom.

devon: Cost check: cloud list p4d pod ~= $31/hr. 3 pods 24/7: 3 * 24 * 30 * 31 = ~$66,960/month (compute only). Add networking, storage, infra overhead.

sre-oncall: Note: us-west-2 inter-pod egress and NLB connection limits may surface at those aggregate token rates. We'll need to validate NIC utilization and NLB backend-target connections.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary: orca-lite-2 -> Fri 09:00 PST; canary size 5% traffic; auto-rollback on p95 > 500ms or >5% errors.

maria: Can someone run a synthetic soak to validate p95/p99 under ramp/hold/spike? If tail latency is bad we should fallback to quantized variant and smaller batch.

jiang: I'll run a 2-hour soak tomorrow with Gatling. Plan: ramp to expected peak 2.5x over 20m, hold 60m, then a 4x spike. Will capture p50/p95/p99 and GPU metrics.

alex: Also want microbench across instance types (p4d vs a100) and with q8/q4 quantized kernels. Model size up ~10% KV cache -> effective batch might drop.

maria: Who owns pre-warm orchestration? devops or infra-scaling? Pre-warm scripts needed to load KV/cache so first requests aren't penalized.

devon: infra-scaling + eng-runtime will take this. I'll own pre-warm runbook and canary rollback hooks.

sam: Finance: if we reserve 3 pods for a month vs pure on-demand, break-even ~18 days. I'll run exact delta and present commit recommendation.

maria: Action items:
- jiang: run soak + post metrics (start tomorrow)
- alex: microbench across instance types and quantized variants
- devon: pre-warm runbook + canary rollback hooks
- sam: cost delta and commit recommendation

maria: Please try to have draft numbers by EOD tomorrow. :pray:

alex: ack.

jiang: started job 02:13 UTC; will post logs when done: http://ci.internal/loadtests/1819002001

sre-oncall: Opening a quick ticket to increase NLB idle timeout and monitor connection resets during soak.

maria: Thanks — ping if you see anything that would block Friday.
